brief:
Tangier authorities in Morocco blocked a planned peaceful demonstration against normalization with Israeli occupation and Zionism for the seventh consecutive time, Shehab Wire reported. The protest had been scheduled for Saturday, August 22, 2026, in Sour Square.

The repeated blocking of the demonstrations reflects ongoing tensions in the port city over Morocco's diplomatic ties with Israel. Organizers have faced consistent official obstruction in their attempts to hold public gatherings opposing normalization agreements.
